profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | R&D Software Engineer 5 | Software chip lead at Broadcom Inc.
profile.summary:
- More than 20 years of experience working in the various areas of Software industry including Embedded, Bluetooth,Wireless, academics, multimedia etc.
- 19 years of experience working in embedded system software environment.
- 10+ years of experience in managing and leading the embedded software project (Product management).
- 10+ years of experience of managing the customer projects involving working closely with the customers for supporting their software queries and working with the internal cross functional teams to get the resolution of the customer issues.
- 3+ years of experience of managing software projects involving the auto test frameworks.
- Experience of working with Bluetooth technology integrated into embedded systems.
- Experience in developing, debugging and testing Broadband system software written in C/C++/Python.
- Strong skills for programming in C/C++, Python and working in UNIX environment.
- Rich exposure to the system software development life cycle with the experience of supporting almost every phase.
- Strong skills of communication and working in a team and leading the software project.
- Strong skills of managing multiple projects in parallel in an efficient manner.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Development, integration and maintenance of the Bluetooth Technology (BlueZ/Fluoride) embedded into system software involving Linux and Android environments.
- Involved as a key SW support for the multiple customer projects and related work with the internal teams.
- Development and managing the autotest environment for various chips and projects.
- Leading the silicon chip specific software stack for multiple Broadband chips (For Settop box).

positions.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
-	Software development in innovative projects: Helped in developing some of the innovative projects of the team involving the HDMI input streaming/controlling over ip, developing SW plugins for data mining for the Artificial Neural Network/Machine learning model for the set top box operations. Developed the python scripts to remotely control and generate the desired system environment to help training the device to become smart device.
-	Leading various projects: Acting as a SW lead (Product management) for various set top box chip projects and acting as a key support engineer (Program management) for the chip specific customer support queries.
-	Development of the system/chip validation stress autotest: Involved in developing the autotest to validate/verify any new chip’s functionality using the stress tests and CRC validation. Developed the program to do CRC check and validation for this methodology.
-	Infrastructure development and maintenance: Involved in developing various infrastructure/setup involving set-top boxes and cable modems for the regression auto-test, remote station access and demo requirements for various projects. Developed the test apps (written in C and python) to be used in these infrastructures.
-	Customer support management: Key technical support for the various customers such as Commscope, Telefonica, Edge Network etc. Worked closely with the customer and internal team leads to identify the issues and helped to get the resolution in a timely manner.

positions.title: Staff-2 Software Engineer
positions.description:
-	Software chip lead: Acted as well as supported the software chip lead in each and every phase of the Software     development life cycle for the chip specific embedded software, starting with the software bring up, developing the features, testing, keeping track of the issues, fixing the bugs, verifying the bug fixes and releasing the software to sqa, supporting customer queries. 
-	Software development: Worked on developing the apps for the new internal feature development. Involved in adding new features in the system software applications driving the audio/video encoding/decoding over ip. Worked on bug fixing in the software code stack.
-	Software Integration: As a software lead for a given project, performed the duties of integrating, testing and releasing the software to the SQA team in a timely manner.
-	Customer support: Provided the key engineering support to the customers like Arris/Commscope for one of their projects. Helped reproducing the issue on the reference board or the customer board, worked with the internal experts to debug the issue, finding, and delivering the solution in the timely manner

positions.title: Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
-	One year experience of working as an intern in Qualcomm - Wireless Business Solutions Department.
-	Developed the automation scripts to test the features of the wireless devices such as TrailorTRACS/GlobalTRACS etc.
-	Developed small application parser in PERL which accepts old formatted automation scripts, parses them and converts them into new format.
-	Worked as an active team member of Wireless system integration and testing team.

positions.title: Lecturer
positions.description:
-	One year experience of working as a lecturer in IT/Computer department.
-	Experience of delivering lectures on programming languages(C, C++), Simulation and Modeling etc. in the class of 60-70 students.
-	Conducted the practical sessions of C, C++, Digital circuit organization and Simulation and modeling.
-	Acted as a course coordinator for 'C' and 'Simulation and modeling' subjects.

honors.title: Community Hero Award - 2014
honors.description:
Broadcom Foundation’s Community Heroes program recognizes civic engagement and volunteerism by employees around the globe.
I got selected as one of those Community Heroes of year 2014. Here is what I got acknowledged for:

Manan V. Patel, Engineer, Staff I - Software Development, San Diego, Calif., is a pioneer in the Broadcom MASTERS Jr. Varsity after-school program, which inspires middle-school students to stick with STEM courses throughout their education. He introduced students in San Diego middle schools to Broadcom's current broadband technology by demonstrating and explaining the differences between SD, HD and UHD technology. Manan also assisted with BAPS Charities’ first walkathon in San Diego, the proceeds of which supported MAP Foundation for Academic Success, Inc., an organization that raises college scholarship funds for Escondido Union High School District.

volunteerExperiences.role: Volunteer for Broadcom Jr MASTERS program
volunteerExperiences.description: Explained and demonstrated the 4K technology and differences between SD vs. HD vs. UHD technology in front of Mid-school students visiting Broadcom as a part of STEM program.

volunteerExperiences.role: Volunteer in fundraising for the Walkathon
volunteerExperiences.description:
As a part of their first WALKATHON event in San Diego this year, I helped with fundraising activities, a portion of which supported MAP Foundation for Academic Success, Inc., an organization that raises college scholarship funds in support of the Escondido Union High School District “MAP Your Future, Reach Your Destination” program.
You can visit the following link to see more details: http://www.bapscharities.org/user/manansandiego/

patents.title: Remote control extender mechanism for a set top box
patents.description: In some aspects, the disclosure is directed to methods and systems for controlling a set top box remotely and monitoring its display output. Remote control commands may be intercepted or captured and forwarded over a network as encapsulated serial data or HDMI-CEC, in some implementations. This data may be transmitted over a network to a processing device, sometimes referred to as an HDMI pass-through and streamer device. The HDMI pass-through device may receive the encapsulated serial data via the network and retransmit the data as CEC data over HDMI to the set top box as if it were any other HDMI capable device, such as a television. Thus, the recipient set top box may receive the remote control commands via CEC and treat them as incoming IR commands and act accordingly.
